title: Agents Detail
description: Cross-harness drill-down for sessions, models, tools, subagents, cost, tokens and errors, with Claude Code-only signals that have no common equivalent.

targets.expr: count(sum by (service_name, session_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | session_id!="" | model=~"$model" [$__range])))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" [$__range]))

sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | model=~"$model" | (agent_event=~".*error.*" or event_name=~".*error.*" or success="false") [$__range]))

sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) / (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])))

sum by (service_name, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__interval]))

sum by (service_name, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens | __error__="" [$__interval]))

sum by (service_name, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" | unwrap output_tokens | __error__="" [$__interval]))

sum by (service_name, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [$__interval]))

sum by (service_name, model) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" [$__interval]))

sum by (service_name, tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="tool_result" or event_name="tool_result" or event_name="codex.tool_result" or tool_name!="") | label_format tool_name=`{{ if .tool_name }}{{ .tool_name }}{{ else }}unknown-tool{{ end }}` [$__range]))

sum by (service_name, tool_name, error_type) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="tool_result" or event_name="tool_result" or event_name="codex.tool_result") | success="false" | label_format tool_name=`{{ if .tool_name }}{{ .tool_name }}{{ else }}unknown-tool{{ end }}` | label_format error_type=`{{ if .error_type }}{{ .error_type }}{{ else }}unspecified{{ end }}` [$__range]))

sum by (service_name, tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="tool_result" or event_name="tool_result" or event_name="codex.tool_result") | success="false" | label_format tool_name=`{{ if .tool_name }}{{ .tool_name }}{{ else }}unknown-tool{{ end }}` [$__interval]))

sum by (service_name, agent_name, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request") and model=~"$model" | query_source=~"agent:.*" | label_format agent_name=`{{ if .agent_name }}{{ .agent_name }}{{ else }}named-spawn{{ end }}` | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range]))

sum by (service_name, agent_name, agent_type, model) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | (agent_event="subagent_completed" or event_name="subagent_completed" or agent_name!="" or agent_type!="") and model=~"$model" | label_format agent_name=`{{ if .agent_name }}{{ .agent_name }}{{ else }}unnamed{{ end }}` | label_format agent_type=`{{ if .agent_type }}{{ .agent_type }}{{ else }}unspecified{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Agent events
panels.description: Trace IDs are rendered in the log line so Loki's configured Tempo derived field links to the trace.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | model=~"$model" | line_format "[{{.service_name}}] session={{.session_id}} event={{if .event_name}}{{.event_name}}{{else}}{{.agent_event}}{{end}} model={{.model}} tool={{.tool_name}} agent={{.agent_name}} trace_id={{.trace_id}}"

panels.title: Errors and failed tools
panels.description: Trace IDs are rendered in the log line so Loki's configured Tempo derived field links to the trace.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"$harness", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | model=~"$model" | (agent_event=~".*error.*" or event_name=~".*error.*" or success="false") | line_format "[{{.service_name}}] session={{.session_id}} event={{if .event_name}}{{.event_name}}{{else}}{{.agent_event}}{{end}} model={{.model}} tool={{.tool_name}} error={{if .error}}{{.error}}{{else}}{{.error_type}}{{end}} trace_id={{.trace_id}}"

panels.title: Claude Code only — Coding and context

targets.expr: sum( (max_over_time(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{job=~".*/claude-code", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range]) - min_over_time(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{job=~".*/claude-code", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range])) )

100 * sum((max_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{job=~".*/claude-code", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", session_id=~"$session_id", decision="accept"}[$__range]) - min_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{job=~".*/claude-code", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", session_id=~"$session_id", decision="accept"}[$__range]))) / clamp_min(sum((max_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{job=~".*/claude-code", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range]) - min_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{job=~".*/claude-code", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range]))), 1)

panels.title: Claude Code · Edit/Write Accept Rate

targets.expr: sum by (trigger) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | event_name="compaction" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Claude Code · Average Tokens Before Compaction
panels.description: Claude-only context compaction signal with no common cross-harness equivalent.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | event_name="compaction" | unwrap pre_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"${host}(\\.local)?|", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment|"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | event_name="compaction" | pre_tokens!="" [$__range]))
